jobs.title: Director, Data Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Details

$165,000 - $200,000 CAD

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance.

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

Transform How Global Transaction Banking Leverages Data, Analytics & AI

As the Director, Data Platform Engineering
, you will define and execute the strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for the Global Transaction Banking (GTB) Data Platform
. Built on Databricks
, the platform serves as the foundation for next-generation data products, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical transaction banking capabilities.

You will lead high-performing engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions while establishing modern engineering practices, platform standards, and delivery excellence across the organization. This role requires a technology leader who combines deep expertise in data engineering and distributed systems with a passion for developing talent, driving innovation, and delivering business outcomes at scale.

Mandate:
Own the strategy, engineering delivery, and operational excellence of the GTB Data Platform, enabling trusted data, advanced analytics, AI innovation, and next-generation transaction banking capabilities through a modern Databricks-powered ecosystem.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Platform Leadership

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the GTB Data Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
Lead the evolution of the Databricks platform, establishing a scalable, secure, and resilient foundation for analytics, data products, AI, and operational workloads.
Drive platform modernization, engineering transformation, automation, and AI-enabled development practices.
Establish engineering and data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for data, APIs, integration, and platform services.
Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations leaders to prioritize investments and accelerate business outcomes.

Engineering & Delivery Leadership

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for data platforms, data products, APIs, streaming services, and cloud-native applications.
Oversee end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for architecture, system design, engineering standards, and modernization initiatives.
Drive engineering excellence through adoption of DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability engineering, and platform engineering practices.
Act as the senior escalation point for critical engineering, platform, operational, and delivery issues.

Data & Technology Leadership

Champion modern data architecture practices, including data products, event-driven architectures, real-time processing, and distributed computing.
Ensure effective governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and platform observability across the GTB ecosystem.
Drive adoption of data and AI capabilities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business decision-making.
Promote reuse, standardization, and scalability of platform capabilities across GTB technology domains.

Financial, Vendor & Governance Management

Accountable for platform investment planning, budget management, forecasting, and delivery performance.
Manage strategic vendor relationships and global delivery partners to achieve business and engineering objectives.
Establish governance processes, performance metrics, and operational controls to ensure transparency and predictable outcomes.
Identify and manage strategic technology, delivery, security, and operational risks.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and senior technical talent.
Build a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, accountability, customer value, and technical excellence.
Drive workforce planning, succession management, capability development, and organizational growth.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship.

Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Technology Management

12+ years of progressive technology experience with significant experience leading large engineering teams and complex technology portfolios.
Proven success leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical professionals.
Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience managing budgets, strategic investments, vendors, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

Data Platform Engineering

Deep expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
Extensive experience with Databricks, including platform architecture, engineering, optimization, governance, and operational management.
Strong experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
Deep understanding of modern data architecture, data products, metadata management, lineage, governance, and data lifecycle management.
Experience building and scaling analytical, operational, and AI-ready data platforms.

Engineering & Architecture

Strong foundation in modern programming languages (Java, Python) and API design (REST, GraphQL).
Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native platform delivery.
Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and DevSecOps / CI/CD practices.
Proven experience building event-driven, real-time data architectures at enterprise scale.
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Confluent, Solace, or Apache Flink.
Familiarity with graph or document data models (Neo4J, MongoDB).
Experience with observability tooling such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or Datadog.
Exposure to OpenShift or other enterprise Kubernetes distributions.

Success Profile

The Successful Candidate Will

Define and execute the vision for the GTB Data Platform.
Scale and modernize a Databricks-centric data ecosystem.
Build and lead world-class data and platform engineering teams.
Deliver secure, resilient, and scalable data products and services.
Advance AI, analytics, and data-driven business capabilities.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability.
Influence technology strategy and transformation outcomes across Global Transaction Banking.

Why Join Us

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of data, analytics, and AI across Global Transaction Banking. You will lead the evolution of a strategic Databricks-powered platform, build exceptional engineering teams, and drive transformative outcomes that directly impact clients, products, and business growth.

Team:
You will lead distributed engineering teams across New York
, Toronto
, and Bangalore
, with global reach and cross-functional partners across the enterprise.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: AVP, Life Pricing and Advanced Analytics
jobs.description:
Career Opportunity

Role Title

AVP, Life Pricing and Advanced Analytics

Purpose of role

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), Life Product Pricing and Advanced Analytics is responsible for leading the pricing and financial analysis of Foresters’ life insurance products across Canada and the U.S., ensuring products deliver competitive customer value while meeting the organization’s profitability, capital and risk objectives.

The role will provide actuarial leadership for new product development and product changes, including the development of Index Universal Life (IUL) in the U.S.; underwriting strategy and innovation; and life reinsurance strategy and relationships. Reporting to the Chief Actuary, the AVP will work closely with Product, Underwriting, Distribution, Finance, Risk and other business partners to support informed product and business decisions.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Life Product Pricing

Lead actuarial pricing and financial analysis for life insurance products across Canada and the U.S.
Provide actuarial leadership for new product development and significant product changes, including the development and launch of Index Universal Life (IUL) in the U.S.
Develop and evaluate pricing assumptions, profitability targets and appropriate sensitivities to support sound product decisions
Assess emerging experience and business results and recommend pricing or product actions where appropriate
Ensure pricing activities comply with applicable actuarial standards and Foresters’ product and actuarial governance requirements

Underwriting & Advanced Analytics

Partner with Underwriting and other business stakeholders on the development and evaluation of underwriting initiatives, including accelerated underwriting
Apply actuarial analysis and advanced analytics to evaluate mortality, underwriting outcomes, risk selection and other drivers of product performance
Translate emerging experience and analytical insights into actionable recommendations for pricing, underwriting and product strategy
Support the development of appropriate frameworks for measuring the financial and risk impacts of changes to underwriting practices

Reinsurance Strategy & Management

Lead the actuarial evaluation of life reinsurance strategy, including the financial and risk implications of alternative structures
Lead or support reinsurance negotiations in partnership with internal stakeholders
Serve as a key relationship manager for Foresters’ life reinsurance partners
Monitor reinsurance market developments and identify opportunities to improve financial outcomes, risk management and product competitiveness

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

Lead and develop a high-performing team of actuarial professionals
Build strong partnerships across Product, Underwriting, Distribution, Finance, Risk and other business functions
Communicate complex pricing, underwriting and reinsurance issues clearly to senior management and decision-making forums
Provide actuarial insight and thought leadership on product strategy, emerging experience and industry developments

Key Qualifications

Fellowship designation (FSA and/or FCIA) with 10+ years of relevant actuarial experience
Strong life insurance product pricing and development experience in Canada and/or the U.S.; experience across both markets is an asset
Strong understanding of life insurance product economics, profitability, capital and risk considerations
Experience with Universal Life and/or Index Universal Life would be a strong asset
Experience with underwriting, mortality analysis, accelerated underwriting or related advanced analytics is highly desirable
Strong understanding of life reinsurance structures and demonstrated experience working with reinsurers
Proven leadership experience with the ability to develop teams and influence across functions
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound business decisions in complex situations
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate technical actuarial analysis into clear business recommendations for senior stakeholders
Results oriented, commercially minded and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on quality and execution.

The actual base salary for this position will depend on several factors, including job-related skills, experience, and education. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may participate in a discretionary variable incentive plan, results are subject to both individual and company performance.

Please note that this posting is intended to fill an existing vacancy; however, there may be instances where more than one vacancy is available for the same role.

at Foresters Financial, we are committed to sustaining an equal opportunity environment for all job applicants. We embrace Inclusion, Diversity and Equity (IDE) as a core strategic objective for building strong, innovative teams in which all our employees can show up wholly and authentically as themselves.

Foresters Financial strives to provide an accessible candidate experience for prospective employees with different abilities. If you anticipate needing any type of accommodations during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@foresters.com in advance of your appointment.

Thank you for choosing Foresters. Only those candidates who will be selected for further consideration will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Director, Wealth Digital AI Platforms & Technology Delivery
jobs.description:
This role is HYBRID, 2 days/week in office (Remote/Virtual is not an option). Out of province candidates will require relocation.

About the role:

BMO Canada Wealth Digital is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its customer-facing digital platforms to enhance client experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovative wealth management solutions. We are seeking an experienced AI Delivery Director to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic AI initiatives that support the evolution of our Wealth Management digital capabilities.

This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring the coordination of cross-functional teams across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Business organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the delivery of secure, compliant, and resilient Multi-Agent AI solutions that leverage enterprise AI capabilities, including the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and AI Observability platforms.

The AI Delivery Director will provide end-to-end leadership across the delivery lifecycle, from intake, discovery, and prioritization through implementation, deployment, adoption, and business value realization by adopting and utilizing AI tools in SDLC. Working closely with engineering leaders, product owners, architects, and executive stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered on schedule, aligned with enterprise standards, and integrated effectively within the broader technology ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technology Delivery
Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.
AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership
Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.
Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration
Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.
Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery
Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.
Quality, Risk and Responsible AI
Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.
Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership
Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

Required Skills And Competencies

Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

Qualifications And Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, engineering, architecture, platform, or product technology leadership, including senior leadership accountability.
Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale digital products or platforms from strategy through production and ongoing operation.
Demonstrated delivery of AI/ML or generative AI solutions in production, ideally involving multi-agent systems or other complex AI-enabled client experiences.
Significant experience with Microsoft Azure and modern software engineering practices in a regulated enterprise.
Experience in wealth management, brokerage, digital investing, banking, or similarly regulated financial services is strongly preferred.
Proven experience leading cross-functional internal and partner teams through complex dependencies and high-stakes releases.
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline; relevant advanced degree or certifications are considered assets.
Experience in Wealth Management or Capital Markets AI space (highly desirable) or Financial Institutions or Technology firms.
Domain knowledge of investment, securities, trading from a technology perspective, having worked in such ecosystems.

Leadership Expectations

Act as an owner: accountable for outcomes, not activity or coordination alone.
Put clients, safety, quality, and sustainable value ahead of pace without evidence.
Create clarity: make responsibilities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery confidence visible.
Lead with technical credibility while empowering engineering and product leaders closest to the work.
Build trust through candor, transparency, inclusion, disciplined follow-through, and continuous learning.

$140,000.00 - $240,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

jobs.title: AVP, Security Domain Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

About the role:

The AVP, Security Architecture is a senior leader accountable for the enterprise security architecture strategy, governance, and evolution of security capabilities across global business and technology environments.

The role translates business priorities, cyber risk appetite, and emerging threats into architecture direction that protects clients, employees, information, and critical services.

Working closely with the CISO, CTO, enterprise architects, and business technology leaders, the AVP leads the Security Architecture function and embeds secure-by-design, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles into enterprise transformation and solution delivery.

The AVP serves as a senior security design authority within enterprise architecture governance, shapes security investment priorities, and develops a team that provides consistent architectural guidance across business units and geographies.

What You Will Do?

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Security Architecture Strategy and Road mapping
Own the enterprise security architecture strategy and target state across identity, cloud, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, data, and security platforms.
Establish multi-year security capability roadmaps aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, the cybersecurity strategy, and organizational risk appetite.
Translate capability assessments, threat trends, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework into prioritized architecture improvements, with Zero Trust and defense in depth guiding modernization.
Security Architecture Function and People Leadership
Lead and develop the Security Architecture team, with accountability for performance, coaching, succession planning, and the skills required to support enterprise priorities.
Define the function's operating model, engagement processes, and service expectations, providing architecture coverage across security programs and business-led technology initiatives.
Prioritize demand and allocate capacity across strategic planning, project assurance, governance, and emerging technology work; establish coverage and knowledge-sharing practices that reduce dependence on individual specialists.
Manage the function's operating plan, assigned budget, and resources, and build business cases for additional capacity or specialist support.
Architecture Governance and Design Authority
Establish security reference architectures, standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails in partnership with global domain architects and enterprise security policy owners.
Serve as senior security design authority for significant initiatives within the enterprise architecture governance process, with clear decision rights and escalation paths.
Represent Security Architecture on enterprise technology review boards, resolve cross-domain design issues, and oversee design assurance against approved security requirements.
Oversee recommendations for architectural exceptions, compensating controls, and remediation plans; escalate material residual risks to accountable business and risk owners through established governance.
Secure Solution Design and Transformation Oversight
Provide security architecture oversight for major business and technology initiatives from early planning through implementation, with review effort proportionate to risk and complexity.
Embed threat modelling, secure design reviews, and reusable security patterns into delivery practices, partnering with application, data, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams.
Lead architectural direction for security transformation programs, including identity modernization, cloud security, network segmentation, application security, data protection, and cyber recovery.
Security Capability Portfolio and Investment Leadership
Direct the strategic evolution, integration, consolidation, and retirement of security tools, services, and capabilities to address enterprise needs and reduce fragmentation.
Shape investment priorities and present business cases that assess risk reduction, control coverage, technical feasibility, interoperability, operational capacity, and total cost of ownership.
Maintain an enterprise view of capability gaps, overlapping technologies, lifecycle risks, and technical debt; partner with engineering, operations, procurement, and vendor management to turn roadmaps into achievable investment and delivery plans.
Technology Evaluation and AI Security
Evaluate emerging security technologies, vendor capabilities, and service models, providing recommendations on suitability, integration, scalability, and long-term viability.
Sponsor proofs of concept with clear success criteria for security effectiveness, technical compatibility, operational readiness, and business value.
Define security architecture requirements and patterns for AI platforms, generative AI, and autonomous agents, addressing identity, data access, tool permissions, monitoring, and human oversight.
Identify opportunities to use automation and AI within security capabilities, working with responsible teams to validate benefits, control effectiveness, and operational accountability.
Architectural Risk and Resilience
Identify systemic security architecture weaknesses and drive mitigation roadmaps with accountable engineering, platform, and business technology owners.
Translate security, privacy, regulatory, and data residency requirements into architecture requirements in partnership with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, and Legal.
Integrate requirements for resilience, ransomware containment, recovery, logging, and monitoring into security designs, working with operational owners to establish implementation and validation expectations.
Use findings from incidents, security testing, audits, and control assessments to improve reference architectures, patterns, and capability roadmaps.
Executive Engagement and Enterprise Partnership
Act as a trusted advisor to the Global Chief Enterprise Architect, CISO, CTO, CIO, and business technology leaders on security architecture strategy and significant technology decisions.
Translate complex architecture choices into clear business implications, investment options, delivery dependencies, and risk treatment recommendations for executive forums.
Build alignment across global business units and technology functions, resolve competing priorities, and report on architecture coverage, adoption, roadmap progress, and outcomes.

What Do You Need to Succeed?

Qualifications Required:

University degree or college diploma in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity architecture, engineering, or related technology leadership roles, including accountability for enterprise security architecture strategy.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing architecture or security teams, managing priorities and resources, and delivering outcomes in a complex, matrixed organization.
Experience influencing VP and SVP stakeholders and presenting architecture strategies, investment recommendations, and risk decisions at executive forums.
Strong knowledge across identity and access management, cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, application, API, and data security, including cryptography and secrets management.
Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise architecture standards, reference patterns, governance processes, and multi-year security capability roadmaps.
Practical understanding of Zero Trust, defense in depth, threat modelling, secure development, and frameworks such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
Experience modernizing security platforms and evaluating vendors or third-party services for technical feasibility, integration, control effectiveness, and total cost of ownership.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the judgment to balance security, business value, delivery constraints, and operational sustainability.

Preferred skills:

Experience in financial services or another regulated industry with global operations and complex privacy or data residency requirements.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud.
Experience defining security architectures for AI, autonomous agents, automation, or other emerging technologies.
Experience with major security transformations, technology rationalization, or mergers and acquisitions integration.
Relevant professional certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or cloud security and architecture certifications.

Key Outcomes and Measures of Success:

Enterprise direction: Approved security target states and prioritized roadmaps aligned with business needs and the cybersecurity strategy.
Architecture coverage: Timely engagement on significant initiatives across business units, with consistent service coverage and review turnaround.
Secure delivery: Greater use of approved patterns and earlier resolution of design weaknesses, reducing avoidable rework and exceptions.
Risk treatment: Progress against remediation plans for material architectural weaknesses and timely escalation of unresolved risks.
Portfolio effectiveness: Reduced capability duplication and technical debt, supported by documented control improvements and lifecycle cost benefits.
Team capability: Improved skills, succession readiness, knowledge sharing, and capacity to support strategic and delivery priorities.
Executive confidence: Clear investment recommendations, transparent reporting, and alignment among security, enterprise architecture, and business leaders.

Unique Requirements:

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only
for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide.

What’s in it for you?

Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
An environment of continuous learning, development, and improvement.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client need to choose where you work, at home or in the office.
A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale and a flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

About the role:

The AVP, Security Architecture is a senior leader accountable for the enterprise security architecture strategy, governance, and evolution of security capabilities across global business and technology environments.

The role translates business priorities, cyber risk appetite, and emerging threats into architecture direction that protects clients, employees, information, and critical services.

Working closely with the CISO, CTO, enterprise architects, and business technology leaders, the AVP leads the Security Architecture function and embeds secure-by-design, Zero Trust, and defense-in-depth principles into enterprise transformation and solution delivery.

The AVP serves as a senior security design authority within enterprise architecture governance, shapes security investment priorities, and develops a team that provides consistent architectural guidance across business units and geographies.

What You Will Do?

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Security Architecture Strategy and Road mapping
Own the enterprise security architecture strategy and target state across identity, cloud, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, data, and security platforms.
Establish multi-year security capability roadmaps aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, the cybersecurity strategy, and organizational risk appetite.
Translate capability assessments, threat trends, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework into prioritized architecture improvements, with Zero Trust and defense in depth guiding modernization.
Security Architecture Function and People Leadership
Lead and develop the Security Architecture team, with accountability for performance, coaching, succession planning, and the skills required to support enterprise priorities.
Define the function's operating model, engagement processes, and service expectations, providing architecture coverage across security programs and business-led technology initiatives.
Prioritize demand and allocate capacity across strategic planning, project assurance, governance, and emerging technology work; establish coverage and knowledge-sharing practices that reduce dependence on individual specialists.
Manage the function's operating plan, assigned budget, and resources, and build business cases for additional capacity or specialist support.
Architecture Governance and Design Authority
Establish security reference architectures, standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails in partnership with global domain architects and enterprise security policy owners.
Serve as senior security design authority for significant initiatives within the enterprise architecture governance process, with clear decision rights and escalation paths.
Represent Security Architecture on enterprise technology review boards, resolve cross-domain design issues, and oversee design assurance against approved security requirements.
Oversee recommendations for architectural exceptions, compensating controls, and remediation plans; escalate material residual risks to accountable business and risk owners through established governance.
Secure Solution Design and Transformation Oversight
Provide security architecture oversight for major business and technology initiatives from early planning through implementation, with review effort proportionate to risk and complexity.
Embed threat modelling, secure design reviews, and reusable security patterns into delivery practices, partnering with application, data, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams.
Lead architectural direction for security transformation programs, including identity modernization, cloud security, network segmentation, application security, data protection, and cyber recovery.
Security Capability Portfolio and Investment Leadership
Direct the strategic evolution, integration, consolidation, and retirement of security tools, services, and capabilities to address enterprise needs and reduce fragmentation.
Shape investment priorities and present business cases that assess risk reduction, control coverage, technical feasibility, interoperability, operational capacity, and total cost of ownership.
Maintain an enterprise view of capability gaps, overlapping technologies, lifecycle risks, and technical debt; partner with engineering, operations, procurement, and vendor management to turn roadmaps into achievable investment and delivery plans.
Technology Evaluation and AI Security
Evaluate emerging security technologies, vendor capabilities, and service models, providing recommendations on suitability, integration, scalability, and long-term viability.
Sponsor proofs of concept with clear success criteria for security effectiveness, technical compatibility, operational readiness, and business value.
Define security architecture requirements and patterns for AI platforms, generative AI, and autonomous agents, addressing identity, data access, tool permissions, monitoring, and human oversight.
Identify opportunities to use automation and AI within security capabilities, working with responsible teams to validate benefits, control effectiveness, and operational accountability.
Architectural Risk and Resilience
Identify systemic security architecture weaknesses and drive mitigation roadmaps with accountable engineering, platform, and business technology owners.
Translate security, privacy, regulatory, and data residency requirements into architecture requirements in partnership with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, and Legal.
Integrate requirements for resilience, ransomware containment, recovery, logging, and monitoring into security designs, working with operational owners to establish implementation and validation expectations.
Use findings from incidents, security testing, audits, and control assessments to improve reference architectures, patterns, and capability roadmaps.
Executive Engagement and Enterprise Partnership
Act as a trusted advisor to the Global Chief Enterprise Architect, CISO, CTO, CIO, and business technology leaders on security architecture strategy and significant technology decisions.
Translate complex architecture choices into clear business implications, investment options, delivery dependencies, and risk treatment recommendations for executive forums.
Build alignment across global business units and technology functions, resolve competing priorities, and report on architecture coverage, adoption, roadmap progress, and outcomes.

What Do You Need to Succeed?

Qualifications Required:

University degree or college diploma in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity architecture, engineering, or related technology leadership roles, including accountability for enterprise security architecture strategy.
Demonstrated experience leading and developing architecture or security teams, managing priorities and resources, and delivering outcomes in a complex, matrixed organization.
Experience influencing VP and SVP stakeholders and presenting architecture strategies, investment recommendations, and risk decisions at executive forums.
Strong knowledge across identity and access management, cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, application, API, and data security, including cryptography and secrets management.
Demonstrated ability to establish enterprise architecture standards, reference patterns, governance processes, and multi-year security capability roadmaps.
Practical understanding of Zero Trust, defense in depth, threat modelling, secure development, and frameworks such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
Experience modernizing security platforms and evaluating vendors or third-party services for technical feasibility, integration, control effectiveness, and total cost of ownership.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the judgment to balance security, business value, delivery constraints, and operational sustainability.

Preferred skills:

Experience in financial services or another regulated industry with global operations and complex privacy or data residency requirements.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, or Alibaba Cloud.
Experience defining security architectures for AI, autonomous agents, automation, or other emerging technologies.
Experience with major security transformations, technology rationalization, or mergers and acquisitions integration.
Relevant professional certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or cloud security and architecture certifications.

Key Outcomes and Measures of Success:

Enterprise direction: Approved security target states and prioritized roadmaps aligned with business needs and the cybersecurity strategy.
Architecture coverage: Timely engagement on significant initiatives across business units, with consistent service coverage and review turnaround.
Secure delivery: Greater use of approved patterns and earlier resolution of design weaknesses, reducing avoidable rework and exceptions.
Risk treatment: Progress against remediation plans for material architectural weaknesses and timely escalation of unresolved risks.
Portfolio effectiveness: Reduced capability duplication and technical debt, supported by documented control improvements and lifecycle cost benefits.
Team capability: Improved skills, succession readiness, knowledge sharing, and capacity to support strategic and delivery priorities.
Executive confidence: Clear investment recommendations, transparent reporting, and alignment among security, enterprise architecture, and business leaders.

Unique Requirements:

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only
for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide.

What’s in it for you?

Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
An environment of continuous learning, development, and improvement.
As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client need to choose where you work, at home or in the office.
A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale and a flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.

What You'll Do
Drive Integrated Media Strategy

Develop customized 360° media strategies
aligned with client business objectives, marketing strategies, consumer needs, and growth opportunities.
Lead integrated media planning and execution across digital and traditional channels
.

Develop a strong understanding of clients' industries, competitive landscapes, business challenges, and opportunities.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and expand strategic partnerships.
Proactively address campaign challenges and develop solutions that protect both performance and client relationships.
Lead and facilitate strategic workshops focused on consumer journeys, messaging, media performance, and business objectives.

Lead & Develop Teams

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of integrated campaigns.
Mentor and coach team members while supporting their professional development.
Share media expertise through internal training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Help establish and evolve media best practices, processes, tools, and methodologies.
Foster a collaborative environment where teams can do their best work.

Drive Operational Excellence

Help ensure effective execution of agency processes, including SOWs, BCRs, hours, invoicing, and campaign workflows
.
Partner with senior leadership to improve processes and ways of working.
Take a proactive, solution-oriented approach to resolving complex project and campaign challenges.

What You'll Bring
5–7+ years of experience
in media strategy, media planning, or a related discipline, primarily within an agency environment.
Strong experience developing and executing integrated/360° media strategies
.
Deep understanding of the modern digital media ecosystem, including programmatic, SEM, paid media, audience strategy, data, measurement, and optimization
.
Solid knowledge of traditional media
, with the ability to connect offline and digital channels into cohesive media strategies.
Experience advising senior stakeholders and major clients
.
Strong presentation, communication, and business skills.
Ability to translate data and media insights into strategic business recommendations.
Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating media strategy teams
.
Strong organizational and project-management skills.
A collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

The Leadership Mindset
We're looking for someone who brings both strategic expertise and strong people leadership
.
Empathetic leader:
You support, coach, and develop people while bringing teams together around a shared vision.
Strategic thinker:
You see the bigger picture and can connect media decisions to broader business and marketing objectives.
Transparent communicator:
You build relationships through honesty, accountability, and trust.

You thrive in complex environments and are comfortable adapting when priorities change.
Collaborative partner:
You believe the strongest work comes from bringing different perspectives and areas of expertise together.

What You'll Get
Hybrid work:
3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely.
Generous time off:
3 weeks of vacation plus an agency-wide holiday closure.
Additional personal time:
Doubled public holidays, 5 personal wellness days, and 1 volunteer day.
Comprehensive benefits:
Life, prescription drug, dental, paramedical, travel, and other coverage options.
Wellness support:
Annual reimbursement toward fitness activities or home fitness equipment.
Transportation benefits:
Discounts on public transit and bike-sharing memberships.
Professional growth:
Work alongside experienced media professionals and have a direct opportunity to influence strategy, processes, and the future direction of the agency.

jobs.title: Director of Digital Marketing (Remote, Calgary)
jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Digital Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.
